text:
deploy-bot: Deploy blocked: values checksum mismatch detected for payments-service chart across regions: eu-west vs us-east. Chart v2.3.4. Canary in eu-west failed admission. See /deploy/details/1748012345. Requesting decision: pin current eu-west to v2.3.3, rollback canary, or hotfix values merge? TTL 30m.
arjun: on it. quick check — is this the values override for connection pool?
liz: I see differences in featureflags + db pool settings in the values file. probably from last-minute staging change.
ben: Can we do a sticky pin for eu-west only until we patch? prefer pin vs rollback if safe.
arjun: pin sounds low-risk. but need release notes note and manual promote once merged. @sam-release you ok with pin?
sam-release: Prefer hotfix if we can patch values quickly, avoids double-promote. timeline ~20m for a values-only hotfix and canary re-run.
qa-runner: QA can validate canary in eu-west after hotfix, but we need a test vector for connection flood edge-case. I'll run smoke tests.
liz: If we hotfix, ensure helm command uses --force? don't force CRDs. use: ```helm upgrade payments-service ./charts/payments --namespace prod-eu --values hotfix/values-pool.yaml --wait```
arjun: Also add an annotation on the release: `release.redwood/ephemeral-fix: true` so ops can track.
ben: :thumbsup: ok let's hotfix. @deploy-bot please allow hotfix bypass for canary job and re-trigger.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Hotfix bypass enabled for thread 1748012345. Triggering promoted canary in 2m. Logs: /deploy/log/1748012345/attempt1
deploy-bot: Canary passed in eu-west. Rolling out staged promotion to us-east in background. Final status: promoted to 30% traffic on eu-west then gradual.
sam-release: I'll add release note snippet: 'payments: fix connection-pool mismatch causing canary admissions; values hotfix applied; monitored 30m'
arjun: closing thread. follow-up: create a prevent-regression check in preflight to compare values-hash across all clusters.
